title: SQLite Database Integration
description: Connect to a SQLite database, create tables, and build CRUD endpoints for items.

steps.title: Database connection and health check
steps.description: Create a SQLite database connection on startup, create an items table, and expose GET /health that returns 200 when the database is ready.
hints: Create the items table with id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY), name (TEXT), and quantity (INTEGER) columns

steps.title: Create item endpoint
steps.description: Implement POST /items that accepts a JSON body with name and quantity, inserts a row into the items table, and returns the created item with its id.
hints: Use db.prepare('INSERT INTO items ...').run() in JS
Return the inserted row id and the provided data

steps.title: List items endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /items that queries all rows from the items table and returns them as a JSON array. Return an empty array if no items exist.
hints: Use db.prepare('SELECT * FROM items').all() in JS
Return the array directly from the endpoint
Make sure each item includes id, name, and quantity fields
